description: Add a font file to a creator's brand fonts from an HTTPS url or file_base64. Before calling, ask the user to confirm exactly: "I have the right to use this font for my content"; only then pass license_confirmed true. Font files are stored privately and are never public. Pass replace with an existing family name to overwrite it.

family.description: Font family name; read from the file when omitted.

file_base64.description: Base64 font file bytes. Provide url or file_base64.

license_confirmed.description: Must be true, and only after the user confirmed they have the right to use this font for their content.

replace.description: Existing family name to replace (keeps its role and usage unless given).

url.description: HTTPS URL of the font file. Provide url or file_base64.

name: bamf.add_brand_font
